'''Ukanis''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] with a round body. By [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], at least one [[Gender/Legends|female]] Ukanis could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and had joined the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]].
